source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 6.2, printed pages 119-120.

blocks.text: Har chemical reaction mein naye bonds banne se pehle reactant molecules ke purane bonds tootte hain. Yeh tabhi ho sakta hai jab reactant molecules itni energy ke saath takrayen (collide karein) ke woh ek energy ki rukawat (energy barrier) ko paar kar saken.

blocks.title: Energy of activation
blocks.text: Woh kam se kam (minimum) energy jo reactant molecules ko sirf is energy barrier ko paar karne ke liye chahiye, energy of activation kehlati hai. Is ki alamat Ea hai.
Exothermic aur endothermic reactions ke energy profile diagrams Figure 6.2 mein diye gaye hain.

blocks.alt: Do energy profiles, Enthalpy banam Progress of Reaction. Baen (exothermic): surkh curve reactants ke level HR se choti (peak) tak charhta aur neeche products ke level HP tak girta hai; dashed teer Ea HR se choti tak, aur seedha teer delta H HR se neeche HP tak; HR aur HP axis par dashed lakeeron se nishan-zada. Daen (endothermic): curve neeche HR (reactants) se choti tak charh kar oopar HP (products) par aata hai; dashed teer Ea HR se choti tak aur teer delta H HR se oopar HP tak.
blocks.caption: Figure 6.2: Delta H aur Ea ke lihaz se energy profile diagram (kitab ki Figure 6.2 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Dono graphs mein curve pehle oopar uthta hai: yeh pahari (hill) activation energy Ea hai jo har reaction ko paar karni parti hai. Exothermic mein products reactants se neeche khatam hote hain (ΔH manfi); endothermic mein products oopar khatam hote hain (ΔH musbat).

blocks.prompt: CH₄(g) + 2O₂(g) → CO₂(g) + 2H₂O(l), ΔH = –890.3 kJ mol⁻¹ ka energy profile diagram banayein.
blocks.explanation: Reactants ki line oonchi rakhein. Curve oopar uth kar pahari (Ea) banata hai, phir 890.3 kJ mol⁻¹ neeche products ki line par aata hai. Yeh exothermic profile hai.

answer_figure.alt: Methane ke jalne ka energy profile: enthalpy (y-axis) banam progress of reaction. Reactants CH₄ + 2O₂ ki line (HR) oonchi hai; surkh curve oopar uth kar pahari banata hai (Ea, reactants se choti tak dashed teer), phir neeche products CO₂ + 2H₂O(l) ki line (HP) par aata hai. HR se HP tak neeche teer: ΔH = −890.3 kJ mol⁻¹ (exothermic).
answer_figure.caption: Jawab ka diagram: cH₄ + 2O₂ → CO₂ + 2H₂O ka exothermic energy profile, ΔH = −890.3 kJ mol⁻¹
answer_figure.long_description: Baen taraf reactants CH₄(g) + 2O₂(g) ki line oopar (HR) hai aur daen taraf products CO₂(g) + 2H₂O(l) ki line neeche (HP). Darmiyan mein curve pahari (energy barrier) banata hai; reactants ki satah se choti tak dashed teer activation energy Ea hai. HR se HP tak neeche ki taraf teer ΔH = −890.3 kJ mol⁻¹ dikhata hai: products ki enthalpy kam hai, is liye heat kharij (release) hoti hai.

blocks.prompt: CaCO₃(s) → CaO(s) + CO₂(g), ΔH = +572 kJ mol⁻¹ ka energy profile diagram banayein.
blocks.explanation: Reactants ki line neeche rakhein. Curve pahari (Ea) ke oopar se guzar kar 572 kJ mol⁻¹ oonchi products ki line par khatam hota hai. Yeh endothermic profile hai; is mein Ea kam se kam ΔH jitni (572 kJ mol⁻¹) honi chahiye.

answer_figure.alt: Calcium carbonate ke decomposition ka energy profile: reactant CaCO₃ ki line (HR) neeche, surkh curve pahari (Ea) ke oopar se guzar kar products CaO + CO₂ ki oonchi line (HP) par khatam hota hai. HR se HP tak oopar teer: ΔH = +572 kJ mol⁻¹ (endothermic, kitab ki qeemat).
answer_figure.caption: Jawab ka diagram: caCO₃ → CaO + CO₂ ka endothermic energy profile, kitab ki qeemat ΔH = +572 kJ mol⁻¹ ke saath (aam taur par maani gayi qeemat taqreeban +178 kJ mol⁻¹ hai)
answer_figure.long_description: Baen taraf reactant CaCO₃(s) ki line neeche (HR) hai aur daen taraf products CaO(s) + CO₂(g) ki line oopar (HP). Curve pahari ke oopar se guzarta hai; HR se choti tak dashed teer Ea hai, jo ΔH se bara hai. HR se HP tak oopar ki taraf teer ΔH = +572 kJ mol⁻¹ (kitab ki qeemat) hai: products ki enthalpy zyada hai, is liye heat jazb (absorb) hoti hai. Data tables mein is reaction ki ΔH taqreeban +178 kJ mol⁻¹ hai; shakal wahi rehti hai.

items: Naye bonds banne se pehle purane bonds tootte hain, is liye reactants ko energy barrier paar karna parta hai; is ke liye kam se kam energy Ea hai.
Energy profile mein pahari Ea hai; products neeche hon to exothermic, oopar hon to endothermic.
